The '''Gotal Bandits''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] present in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They had a [[Gotal Pirates' Base|base]] located near the edge of the star system that provided a string tactical advantage for their raids against civilian traffic.<ref name="SWG:TGPB" />

In space battles, Gotal Bandits flew [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s, [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]] and [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>
{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Gotal Bandits appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Gotal Bandits were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />
